categories.syntax: `$sN` `$SN` `$mN` `$MN` `$m` - a value of this spell's effect N
`$oN` - (total of a periodic effect N of this spell)
`$aN` - (radius of effect N of this spell)
`$tN` `$t` - (tick period of effect N of this spell)
`$d` - (duration of this spell)
`$h` `$n` `$u` - (proc chance / proc charges / max stacks of this spell)
`$<spell>sN` `$<spell>mN` - an effect value of another spell
`$<spell>aN` - (radius of an effect of another spell)
`$<spell>tN` - (tick period of an effect of another spell)
`$<spell>d` - (duration of another spell)
`$<spell>n` `$<spell>u` - (proc charges / stacks of another spell)
`$/N;<ref>` `$*N;<ref>` - a reference divided / multiplied by a constant
`${ ... }` with optional `.N` precision suffix - an expression
`$proccooldown`, `$rap`, `$bh`, `$bc` ... - a named (not numbered) value
`$<name>` - a variable defined outside the template
`$lone:many;` `$Lone:many;` - singular/plural selected by the preceding number
`$?<cond>[then][else]` - text chosen by a client-side condition
`$@spelltooltip<spell>` - another spell's whole tooltip, inlined
`|CAARRGGBB` ... `|R` - colour markup
`\r\n` - explicit line breaks inside the template
anything the tokenizer does not recognise (must stay empty)
